name: Ogawa Chiharu
source:
Hobbies: Thinking of Yuu
Likes: Amakawa Yuu

A girl with beautiful long black hair.

She shared the same classroom with [url=https://vndb.org/c50516]Yuu[/url] since Junior high, and is his only female friend at school. Even though their interactions are limited to school, she has known him longer than anyone else except for the Disobeyers working with him.

Her parents are both well and alive, but she lives on her own in an apartment near the school because of family circumstances. 

[From the Official Artbook]
